title: Multimodal transformer stratifies postoperative risk in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma
summary: A transformer-based deep-learning pipeline fuses clinical variables, radiomic features and whole-slide pathology images to predict 2-year overall survival after surgery, with AUCs of 0.952, 0.924 and 0.924 in three independent validation cohorts. Spatial transcriptomics and proteomics indicated that the model attention focused on regions associated with tumor invasion and aggressive behavior.
ai_technology: Transformer network fusing a pre-trained encoder with clinical, radiomic and pathology data

evidence.tested: Three independent multicentre validation cohorts plus spatial transcriptomics and proteomics analysis of attention.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective cohorts; not shown to change treatment outcomes; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: The transformer fused multimodal data to predict survival and its attention was examined biologically.

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
